name: last-flame
description: Last Flame: a little flame with seconds to live. Nine levels of running, jumping and dashing; burn lamps for more time; carry the fire to the Eternal Fire.

scripts.check: for f in server.mjs shared/*.js src/*.js test/*.mjs tools/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.package: rm -rf dist && node tools/build.mjs && cd dist && zip -q last-flame-web.zip index.html && mkdir 'Last Flame' && cp LastFlame.html 'Last Flame/' && cp ../tools/PLAY-ME.txt 'Last Flame/PLAY ME.txt' && zip -qr last-flame-download.zip 'Last Flame' && rm -r index.html 'Last Flame' && ls
